newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank sells 35-day bills, rate falls.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank sells 35-day bills, rate falls.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 63 million kuna worth of 35-day bills at 7.50 percent at a regular auction, down 50 basis points after being stuck at 8.0 perent for months.
Banks bid only 70 million kuna as they ran into a temporary kuna shortage, partly due to Tuesday's reserve payment.
Volume fell from 271 million kuna issued in 35- and 91-day bills last week.

The reserve requirement was slightly higher at 3.32 billion kuna because of relatively high deposits in the banking system, an official told Reuters. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
